filed: 2026-11-22, compare-lead, before experiments/adl/kl_control.py was first run
descriptive_note: nine saved pairs, seed sd 0.013 against a floor of 0.0054: no claim at the bar; reported as read (user, proposal 56, 2026-11-22)

inputs.lens: experiments/adl/results/amend1/items/<pair>-<state>.json (E265): .D, .pair, .side, .state, .c, .size; pair items only, random items kept for the floor
inputs.kl_norm: experiments/kl_control/results/summary.json .B_pairs.states (E262 from E257): .kl, .logkl, .norm per state; a state the lens read times c != 1 is E257's '<state with / as ->_scaled_<pair>'

same_state_check: the lens multiplied the larger side by E187's c (experiments/adl/run.py pair_items, World.change), as E257 did; so E257's KL of the scaled state is the KL of the update the lens read. Checked per state: lens .size equals E262 .norm within 1e-6 relative (the lens's own size_rel)

expected.control_D_on_D: D regressed on D (intercept + D) leaves every residual pair gap 0 within 1e-12: float64 rounding of residuals is ~eps 2.2e-16 x max|D| 0.18 x 76 states ~ 3e-15
expected.raw_gaps: equal E265's compare.json adl gap per pair within 1e-12 (same items, seed means per side)
expected.floor: largest |D| over the 18 pair-side random updates = 0.0054 (E265)
expected.norm_fit: sizes are matched within a pair, so the norm fit should move the pair gaps little (as for E_b in E262, whose resid_norm equals raw)

rules.pair_gap: mean residual over a side's states (reuse) minus mean over the other side's (new); OLS with intercept over the unique trained pair states (random items out)
rules.outside: |residual gap| > floor (floor = measured max |D| over the 18 pair-side random items)
rules.sign_agree: count of the nine pairs where sign(lens residual gap) == sign(E_b residual gap under the same regressor); also against E_b raw gap
rules.spearman: Spearman of the nine lens residual gaps with E_b's residual gaps under the same regressor (P2.51's spearman)
rules.rival_a: under the filed KL fit: at least 4 of the 7 'apart' pairs have |residual gap| <= floor AND sign agreement with E_b's resid_kl <= 6 of 9 AND Spearman < 0.5
rules.rival_b: under the filed KL fit: all four large_pairs have |residual gap| > floor AND Spearman >= 0.5
rules.otherwise: mixed: reported as read, no call
